# Anatomy kit (vendored)

Drawing kit from [wheresryan22/anatomy](https://github.com/wheresryan22/anatomy), MIT licence (see `LICENSE`).
Copied unchanged: `iso-kit.mjs`, `lathe.mjs`, `iso.css`. Used by `web/scripts/anatomy/*.mjs` to build the
isometric device figures shown in the diagnosis view; the built SVG is committed under `web/src/anatomy/`.
